Question
========
What is the benefit of community participation in data management?

Answerlist
----------
* It helps to create a universal framework applicable to any data management pipeline
* It allows sharing of tools, standards, and best practices
* It contributes to development of international standards of data safety
* It prevents industrial espionage


Solution
========
Community participation allows sharing of tools, standards, and best practices.

Answerlist
----------
* False
* True
* False
* False
